propositions: Plan-review attestations must record signed material pins for direct children and prerequisites to bind the reviewed plan to related ticket material states at review time.

Material drift in a pinned ticket invalidates its downstream attestation only when the intermediate ticket's material actually changes and enforcement is enabled; propagation is deliberate rather than eager.

Ticket state includes a reducer-maintained plan_review_phase projection with values planning or execution, derived from process_status transitions and surviving compaction; only winning STATUS events update the phase.

Execution reviews apply a fixed 0.80 priority floor in blocking-threshold resolution; execution attestations are compatible only when their manifest floor is at least 0.80 or the review is in planning mode.

Prerequisite consistency evaluation receives deterministic coverage records per canonical prerequisite with dispositions consistent, finding, or indeterminate; indeterminate records with incomplete evaluation or attribution yield unsigned reviews.

Close operations require a current certified compatible plan review when both require_plan_review_for_close and enforce_plan_material_pins are enabled; code freshness alone never invalidates close-profile validity.
